sub_graphs.title: EIP-5757: External Resource Origin Approval Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transitions of external resource origins in the EIP approval process

nodes.label: Origin Proposed for Approval
nodes.description: A new external resource origin has been proposed for inclusion in EIP-approved origins

nodes.label: Evaluate Against Requirements
nodes.description: EIP editors evaluate the origin against mandatory criteria

nodes.label: Origin Under Evaluation
nodes.description: Origin is being evaluated against identification, availability, and access requirements

nodes.label: Check Unique Identification Capability
nodes.description: Verify origin provides method to uniquely identify resource revisions

nodes.label: Unique Identification Verified
nodes.description: Origin can uniquely identify revisions via git hashes, version numbers, or dates

nodes.label: Check Proven Availability History
nodes.description: Verify origin has proven history of availability (e.g., 10 years)

nodes.label: Availability History Verified
nodes.description: Origin has demonstrated reliable long-term availability

nodes.label: Check Free Access Requirement
nodes.description: Verify origin does not charge fees for accessing resources

nodes.label: Free Access Verified
nodes.description: Origin provides free access to all resources

nodes.label: Origin Approved
nodes.description: Origin is listed in EIP-1 with formatting specifications

nodes.label: Origin Rejected
nodes.description: Origin failed to meet one or more mandatory requirements

external_entities.name: Ethereum Community Member
external_entities.description: Developer or community member proposing a new external resource origin

external_entities.name: EIP Editor
external_entities.description: Editor responsible for evaluating origin compliance with requirements

sub_graphs.title: EIP-5757: Origin Validation Requirements
sub_graphs.description: Models the three mandatory validation requirements for external resource origins

nodes.label: Origin Candidate for Validation
nodes.description: An origin to be validated against EIP-5757 requirements

nodes.label: Validate Revision Identification
nodes.description: Check if origin provides unique revision identifiers (git hash, version, date)

nodes.label: Uses Git Commit Hashes
nodes.description: Origin identifies revisions via git commit hashes

nodes.label: Uses Version Numbers
nodes.description: Origin identifies revisions via version numbers

nodes.label: Uses Publication Dates
nodes.description: Origin identifies revisions via publication dates

nodes.label: Revision Identification Valid
nodes.description: Origin has at least one valid revision identification method

nodes.label: Validate Availability Longevity
nodes.description: Check if origin has sufficient history of reliability

nodes.label: Has 10+ Year History
nodes.description: Origin has demonstrated 10 years of reliable service

nodes.label: Availability Longevity Valid
nodes.description: Origin meets availability history requirements

nodes.label: Validate Zero Cost Access
nodes.description: Check if origin provides free access to resources

nodes.label: Zero Cost Access
nodes.description: Origin does not charge for resource access

nodes.label: All Validation Requirements Met
nodes.description: Origin passes all three mandatory requirements

sub_graphs.title: EIP-5757: Origin Removal and Re-approval
sub_graphs.description: Models the process when an approved origin no longer meets requirements

nodes.label: Origin Currently Approved
nodes.description: Origin is currently listed in EIP-1 as an approved resource

nodes.label: Detect Requirement Violation
nodes.description: System or editor detects that origin no longer meets requirements

nodes.label: Requirement Violation Detected
nodes.description: Origin has been found to violate one or more requirements

nodes.label: Remove Origin from EIP-1
nodes.description: Remove the origin from the list of approved origins in EIP-1

nodes.label: Origin Removed from Approved List
nodes.description: Origin is no longer in the approved origins list

nodes.label: Origin Fixes Violation
nodes.description: Origin provider addresses the issue that caused violation

nodes.label: Violation Fixed
nodes.description: The requirement violation has been addressed

nodes.label: Reapply for Approval
nodes.description: Origin undergoes re-evaluation for approval

nodes.label: Origin Re-approved
nodes.description: Origin has been re-approved after fixing violations

external_entities.name: Origin Provider
external_entities.description: Organization or entity that provides the external resource origin

ambiguities.text: Ten years of availability is described as 'sufficient' but not 'necessary' for meeting the availability requirement
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume ten years is a strong benchmark, but EIP editors have discretion to approve origins with shorter history if other factors demonstrate reliability.

ambiguities.text: No specification for how frequently approved origins should be re-evaluated for continued compliance
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume re-evaluation occurs on a best-effort basis or when issues are reported by the community.

ambiguities.text: The term 'free access' is not defined - unclear if this includes requiring account registration
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'free' means no monetary cost; registration or authentication requirements may be acceptable if no payment is required.

implicit_assumptions.description: External resource origins will maintain their availability and free access policies indefinitely
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: EIPs referencing removed origins would have broken or paywalled references, reducing specification accessibility.

implicit_assumptions.description: External origins will not modify historical resource revisions after publication
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Referenced specification content could be altered, causing implementers to build against modified specifications.

implicit_assumptions.description: EIP editors will consistently and fairly evaluate origin approval requests
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent evaluation could lead to important origins being rejected or unreliable origins being approved.
